summary: 48-tooth MOD 0.8 spur gear with a 14 mm center bore and eight radial slotted holes on a circular pattern. Outer diameter is computed from the module as 0.8*(48+2)=40 mm, with a 38.4 mm pitch diameter. Thickness is estimated from the side view.

mountingSurfaces.description: Front flat face of the gear. It appears to have a slightly recessed web inside the tooth rim, and the eight slotted holes can be used to mount a hub.
Back flat face, which looks fully flat in the images.

notes: The 40 mm outer diameter and 14 mm bore come from the MOD and tooth count and from the product data. The 6 mm thickness is estimated from the side view proportions. The eight slots measure about 4 mm wide and 4.7 mm long, elongated radially. Their bolt-circle radius of about 11.6 mm is measured from pixel scale and is approximate. The depth of the face recess is not visible, so it is not modeled.
